component.provider: Test-only injection connects actual file_store native guards to in-process RPC/XDR dispatch; production wire:true acquisition is first verified to decline.

checks: CREATE_SESSION binds a bidirectional transport; CB_NULL uses the requested program/version and AUTH_NONE while forechannel RPC stays usable
probe replies are bound to their exact TCP connection and XID; cross-connection, duplicate and unknown replies cannot change path state
BACKCHANNEL_CTL changes program and invalidates old probes; malformed matched replies keep path down and idempotent rebinding reprobes it
cleared callback credentials and destroyed/recreated sessions cannot be validated by a stale probe response
BIND_CONN_TO_SESSION supports BACK and BACK_OR_BOTH on new transports, rejects invalid directions and changes to existing channel roles
AUTH_SYS CB_NULL carries the offered timestamp, machine name, UID/GID and supplementary groups exactly
five-second probe timeout ignores late success; rebind recovers the path without recreating the session
losing the only callback transport sets CB_PATH_DOWN on a surviving forechannel connection
CB_NULL success alone does not validate the sequenced backchannel; CB_SEQUENCE success on the wrong transport is ignored
truncated/trailing XDR and mismatched status/tag/count/op/session/sequence/slot close the transport before exact retry; only a valid success advances the slot
successful CB_SEQUENCE advances exactly once; BACKCHANNEL_CTL retains the session sequence and ignores old duplicate replies
BIND and callback program replacement never retry an outstanding CB_COMPOUND on a live transport; its original reply releases the slot without validating the new program
completion of a callback issued before credential removal advances its slot but cannot resurrect the disabled backchannel
CB_COMPOUND timeout closes the original transport before retry; stale RPC replies on the replacement cannot complete the unresolved slot
one callback slot serializes multiple bound paths; transport loss retries the unresolved request on another bound connection
loss of the only backchannel with an unanswered CB_COMPOUND reports CB_PATH_DOWN_SESSION; binding a replacement clears that flag and preserves the pending sequence
client-advertised slot growth beyond CREATE_SESSION and shrink back to zero are accepted without allocation or increasing callback concurrency
destroying and recreating a session starts a distinct callback slot at sequence one; old CB_COMPOUND success cannot validate it
UINT32_MAX offered callback slots require only slot zero; AUTH_SYS credentials must fit the negotiated complete CB_COMPOUND request size
OPEN advertises MAY_NOTIFY_LOCK; READW conflict release delivers exact handle/owner/referring request; the hint neither grants nor reserves the lock
nonblocking LOCK denial does not enroll a waiter and cancels a previous blocking request for the same owner/file
closing the waiting OPEN removes its unsent notification without granting lock state
fresh write-policy authority is required before dispatch; revocation drops the waiter and restoring rights does not resurrect it
inconsistent operation status and lost notification reply cause disconnect then exact two-operation replay; RETRY_UNCACHED_REP consumes the slot without granting a lock
multiple waiting owners share one bounded callback slot and no second notification is sent before the first completes
client NOTSUPP completes the optional callback; foreground polling and explicit lock acquisition remain usable
two-operation callbacks respect negotiated operation and full RPC size limits; constrained clients can still poll for locks
expired client and OPEN state remove the queued hint; releasing the competing lock never notifies or revives the expired session
EXPORT and DUMP filter root-squashed/unmapped principals; duplicate MNT is idempotent
mount records survive reconnect; UMNT/UMNTALL affect only caller and preserve NFS filehandles
rpcbind DUMP/GETVERSADDR advertise implemented TCP services plus UDP NSM; older NLM versions remain absent
recognized unsupported file types return per-operation errors after successful SEQUENCE/PUTFH
BACKCHANNEL_CTL updates bounded callback configuration; unknown GSS, SP4_NONE SET_SSV and obsolete v4.0 operations return defined per-operation errors
optional pNFS/delegation/attribute operations are decoded and return NOTSUPP with their own operation number, not OP_ILLEGAL
WANT_DELEGATION with no explicit delegation preference returns INVAL and stops the compound
AUTH_NONE negotiates through a separately scoped anonymous identity; no file access or AUTH_SYS reply reuse; anonymous policy revocation invalidates security replies
export revocation immediately hides discovery and denies subsequent MNT
all 72 OPEN access/preference/hint combinations encode exact NONE/NONE_EXT reasons without gaining data rights or promising callbacks
invalid OPEN preferences/access bits stop before CREATE and do not mutate the namespace
CLAIM_FH honors cancellation while upgrading ordinary OPEN rights; exact slot replay does not advance the state twice
standalone WANT_DELEGATION ignores data-access bits, returns extended reasons, supports idempotent cancellation and preserves the current filehandle
standalone validation distinguishes invalid preference, missing handle, directory refusal, unsupported previous-client recovery and grace/reclaim errors
WANT refuses unmapped callers, reauthorizes cached replies after export revocation and creates no hidden OPEN/client-busy state
real service restart preserves ordinary OPEN reclaim while rejecting invented delegation recovery during grace and after RECLAIM_COMPLETE
default lease is 60 seconds; configured five-second lease is advertised and SEQUENCE renews OPEN beyond its initial expiry
idle session and OPEN expire at the advertised lease; another client opens the file while the expired stateid remains invalid
reducing the lease preserves the old reclaim window across repeated restarts, then converges to the configured duration after grace

limits: No production delegation handout: native provider must cover host metadata/namespace changes and worker death before it can certify wire safety.
No end-to-end delegation recovery, WRITE delegations, CB_GETATTR or availability/push callbacks yet.
Named CLAIM_DELEGATE_CUR and authenticated Kerberos/SSV CB_RECALL need further implementation/acceptance; component coverage uses CLAIM_DELEG_CUR_FH and AUTH_NONE callbacks.
Durable delegation ownership records are not proof of reclaim.
The full upstream delegation gate remains open; no failed upstream case was reclassified as passing.
New component suite and SQLite cleanup repair still require remote MSVC/GCC/Clang acceptance.
validation_order: Shared backchannel/CB_NOTIFY_LOCK regression ran before the final EXCHANGE_ID guard for detached delegations. The final component suite exercises that additional ownership guard and final upgrade/replay behavior.
